scene.prompt: Kyoto: grid streets of the old imperial capital, temple pagodas and palace roofs in a basin ringed by wooded hills
Kamakura: seat of the shogunate between steep wooded hills and Sagami Bay, the Hachiman shrine avenue, Zen temples, the great bronze Buddha
Hakata: busy Kyushu harbour with Chinese junks, warehouses, Zen temples and a long stone defence wall along the bay
Sakai: moated merchant city on Osaka Bay, storehouses, sake breweries, tea houses and foreign ships at anchor
Echigo: deep snow over rice paddies and steep thatched farmhouses beneath high mountains on the Sea of Japan coast
